summary: Improve job criteria, structured interviews, and hiring data review with practical inclusive recruitment training. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Inclusive recruitment training helps recruiters, HR professionals, and hiring managers design fairer selection processes and assess candidates consistently. It develops practical skills in reviewing job criteria, mapping candidate barriers, and creating structured interview guides and scoring matrices, while introducing accessible communications and human review of AI-assisted screening.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape job requirements, attract applicants, assess candidates, or oversee inclusive recruitment and hiring practices.
modules: Job Analysis and Inclusive Job Descriptions
prerequisites: Working knowledge of recruitment or selection processes is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for the sample hiring-data exercise; advanced AI governance and accessibility standards are introduced at overview level rather than technical implementation depth.
